transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Yeah, um… I guess I came in because my appetite’s been off the last few weeks. It’s probably not a huge thing, but even after my shifts, foods I usually like just kind of sit there, and I end up forcing down a few bites. I figured I should get it checked out, if that makes sense.
Have you lost any weight over the past few weeks?

I’m not totally sure about the weight, honestly. I haven’t really been checking. It’s more that for the last few weeks my appetite’s just been kind of… off. Even after work, stuff I usually like just sits there and I only manage a few bites. I don’t know if that’s the kind of thing you mean.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?

Yeah… I mean, I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but most days I do feel pretty down. It’s like this heavy, kind of flat feeling I’m carrying around. Even when I’m at home with my family or in the break room at work, I’m there, but I don’t really feel… there, if that makes sense.
Have you noticed any change in your clothing size over the past few weeks?

Not really clothing size, no… or I haven’t noticed anything obvious like that. It’s more just that I’ve barely had an appetite the last few weeks. Even after a shift, food I usually like just kind of sits there, and I force down a few bites. Does that answer what you’re asking?
Have you lost a significant amount of weight unintentionally?

I wouldn’t want to say “significant” if I don’t know for sure, because I haven’t really weighed myself. But… I did come in because these last few weeks my appetite’s been really low. Even after a shift, foods I normally like just kind of sit there, and I end up forcing down a few bites. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Have you noticed any change in how your clothes fit over the past few weeks?

I haven’t really noticed my clothes fitting differently, no. I probably should pay more attention to that. It’s more that, like I said, for the last few weeks my appetite’s been pretty low. Even stuff I usually want after work just kind of sits there, and I only get a few bites down. Is that helpful?
Have you had anyone comment on your weight loss recently?

No, I don’t think anyone’s actually said anything to me about losing weight. I’m not even sure I have, honestly. It’s more just… the appetite thing. For the last few weeks I’ve barely wanted to eat, even stuff I usually like after a shift. I’ll kind of pick at it and force down a few bites. Is that okay to mention, even if I don’t know about the weight part?
Have you lost any weight at all since your appetite changed?

I’m honestly not sure if I’ve actually lost weight. I haven’t been checking. What I can say is that since this appetite change started, I’ve barely been eating much—like after a shift, even food I usually like just kind of sits there, and I make myself take a few bites. So… maybe, but I don’t want to say for sure if I don’t know.
Have you noticed any change in your body shape or appearance since your appetite changed?

Not really, no—I haven’t noticed my body looking different or anything. I mean, I came in because these last few weeks I’ve just barely had an appetite. Even food I’d normally want after work kind of just sits there, and I have to make myself take a few bites. But as far as my appearance, I’m not sure I’ve seen a change. Is that okay?
Have you noticed any looseness in your clothes that fit you well before?

I haven’t really noticed my clothes fitting looser, no. I mean, maybe I just haven’t been paying close attention. The main thing I’ve noticed is just that these last few weeks I barely feel like eating—even stuff I usually like after a shift, I’ll just kind of stare at it and make myself take a few bites. Is that helpful?
Have you had to buy smaller clothes because your old ones are too big?

No, I haven’t had to buy smaller clothes or anything like that. I don’t think it’s gotten to that point. It’s more that for the last few weeks I just haven’t had much of an appetite, and even after work, food I usually like just kind of sits there and I have to force down a few bites. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Have you had any issues with feeling full after eating very little food?

A little, maybe… I don’t know if I’d call it feeling full exactly. It’s more like for the last few weeks I just haven’t had much of an appetite, so even foods I usually like after a shift just kind of sit there, and I end up forcing down a few bites. Does that answer what you’re asking?
Have you noticed any difference in how your body feels or how you look in the mirror?

Not really in the mirror, no… I mean, I don’t think I look that different. It’s mostly that I came in because the last few weeks I’ve barely had any appetite. Even stuff I usually like after a shift just kind of sits there, and I have to make myself take a few bites. I’m not sure if that’s the kind of difference you’re asking about.
Have you noticed any change in your weight when you look at yourself in the mirror?

Not really from looking in the mirror, no. I haven’t noticed a clear weight change. It’s more that I came in because, for the last few weeks, I’ve barely had an appetite… even food I usually like after work just kind of sits there, and I have to force myself to eat a few bites. Is that helpful?
Have you lost any weight at all since your appetite changed that you're aware of?

I’m not totally sure, to be honest. I haven’t really weighed myself or noticed some big drop. It’s just… these last few weeks my appetite’s been pretty low, and even after a shift, food I normally like just kind of sits there. I’ll make myself eat a few bites, but that’s about it. Does that make sense?
Have you lost more than 5% of your body weight since your appetite changed?

I don’t know if it’s been more than 5%… I haven’t really checked my weight like that. I just know for the last few weeks my appetite’s been pretty lousy, and even food I usually like after a shift, I kind of just stare at it and force down a few bites. I’m sorry, I wish I had a clearer number for you.
Have you noticed any significant weight loss when you stepped on a scale?

I haven’t really stepped on a scale, so I can’t say there’s been significant weight loss. I know that’s not the most helpful answer… it’s more that my appetite’s just been off the last few weeks. Even after work, foods I normally like just sit there, and I end up forcing down a few bites.
Have you had someone notice or comment on your weight loss recently?

No, I don’t think anyone’s really said anything to me about losing weight. I mean, I came in more because for the last few weeks I’ve barely had an appetite… even stuff I usually like after a shift just kind of sits there, and I make myself take a few bites. I’m not sure if that’s the kind of thing you’re asking.
Have you intentionally tried to lose weight over the past few weeks?

No, I haven’t been trying to lose weight or anything like that. It’s more just… I came in because the last few weeks I’ve barely had an appetite, and even food I usually like after a shift just kind of sits there. I’ll force down a few bites, but it’s not on purpose.
Are you worried about gaining weight?

No, not really. I’m not worried about gaining weight or trying to avoid it. It’s more just that my appetite’s been pretty low the last few weeks… even after work, stuff I’d normally want just kind of sits there, and I end up making myself eat a few bites. Is that what you mean?
